## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · devx seat 2 · 2026-10-27T01:53Z

Seat `domain:devx#2` (#20163) · `session_01Q4MDXRbEJCNdPAP4SiXwp9` · reviewed head `471629f0` · card #26084, claim 6430725035 (wave 8, delta B). PR carries `Part of #26084` (the Test UI half is not here; see below). Tier H (`check-governed-merges`: governed, tier H, humanMerge); +744/−28. Draft until a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval; the seat does not ready or queue it before then. It edits root `ci.yml`, which the maintainer also asked to approve explicitly.

- **Design accepted: drop empty shards, never re-size.** `test-plan` runs the shards' own selection (`select-shard-packages.sh`, same event env) and `planRun()` at SHARD_COUNT 8 once, and publishes the non-empty bin indices plus a digest. A started shard keeps its name `Test Core (k/8)`, its `--shard k/8` slice, cache key and attestation, so no package moves and no shard grows. The thread's 10/10 single-package probes filling all eight bins are why re-sizing would double wall time; agreed.
- **Fail-open holds on every path I traced.** Plan job red or timed out → no outputs → `fromJSON('' || '[1..8]')` → full roster, and the gate's `OS_TEST_PLAN` uses the same expression, so the two count the same roster. Filter says no core paths → `test-plan` and `test` both skip on the same clause. Only the literal `[]` skips `test` on the plan's word, and the gate then expects zero credentials. The `if:` keeps `!cancelled()` without `success()`, so a failed `test-plan` cannot skip the shards.
- **The plan cannot silently disagree with the shards:** each shard ends its package-set step with `--verify` against the plan digest and goes red, naming both, on a mismatch. An empty digest is the fallback case and passes. The planner's `--self-test` runs inside `test-plan` before it publishes, so a broken planner costs runners, never coverage.
- **Required contexts unchanged:** only the aggregate `Test Core` is registered (`check-required-contexts.mjs` L417); `test-plan` is declared a non-member in the roster with its reason, and the roster / partition self-tests are updated to the new spellings.
- **The cost, stated for the approver:** one serial hop of ~65–95 s (checkout + install + selection) before any Test Core shard starts, on every run that starts Test Core, including core PRs that fill all eight bins. The saving is ~43% of shard jobs (72 of 168 over 25 runs, ~7,000 runner-seconds). The PR body says so; I accept the trade as the card's intent (runner waste), but it is the one thing in this PR that is a choice rather than a fix.

**Not in this PR, and why:** the card's Test UI half. Its 16-way denominator is pinned by `ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts` (a `ui/` file, outside this lane), and 0 of 336 Test UI shards were empty in the sample, so the premise does not hold there today. The seat will ask for a ui-lane card if it is still wanted. The card stays open on `Part of`.
